description: This file defines the interface HonoPasswordEncoder in Java, which provides methods for encoding passwords and matching raw passwords against encoded secrets within the Hono project. It acts as a helper for password management related to Hono's credential service.

classes.name: HonoPasswordEncoder
classes.description: An interface for encoding passwords and verifying raw passwords against credential secrets in the Hono framework.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Computes a hash for a raw password, returning a JsonObject representing the secret, which includes hash details, salt, and function used.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a raw password matches the stored credential secret, returning true if it does.
